note: 采访罗密欧与朱丽叶的四天 sound plan v7 (24 Nov, the owner's notes on the v6.1 cut: B02 a second later, the potion scene in her room with its cork, swallows, glass and fall, the throw on 拍不下去, the shorter black after it). v6 (24 Nov, the owner's notes on the v5 cut: the new lines, her two whispers to herself with their room dip, no gallop in Mantua). v5 (23 Nov, the owner's notes on the v4 cut: the duel's blades and falls and the slow-motion throw's swell, made in code; the 插手 tally's sounds only round her refusals; the rider rides on; one soft heartbeat where the heart eyes were). Frames from the picture's own dump (/home/user/romeo_work/sound/v7/frames.json, written from src/videos/romeo), as scene anchors by /home/user/romeo_work/sound/make_cues.py. Music: eight original lute pieces synthesised in code (no samples); none in the turn (E), the letter's failure (G) or the quiet scene (H). Effects from the library, the sound farm (romeo-sfx-01) and v5/synth.py.
